scope: The main Shilin Official Residence building and its physically connected wings, including the covered entry and the immediate driveway loop.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Taipei identifies the main building at 60 Fulin Road as a two-story pitched-roof structure combining wood and reinforced concrete. It was enlarged in use, and restoration was completed in November 2009.
The Taipei city gazetteer identifies the two-story Western-style central residence and describes walls painted green to blend into the landscape.
